visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men sit at a table in a studio with shelves holding books, figurines, and a clock. The man on the left wears a gray hoodie, and the man on the right wears a black hoodie. They look at the camera and talk animatedly. (2) Both men raise their arms in a celebratory gesture as a score overlay appears between them. They point and gesture as they discuss various 'aging' traits. (3) The camera alternates between medium shots of both men and close-ups of their individual expressions as they react to quiz questions. (4) A blue skincare bottle is placed on the table in front of the man in the black hoodie. He picks it up and demonstrates its use. (5) Extreme close-ups show the blue bottle and text detailing ingredients. (6) A close-up shot shows a hand applying a creamy yellow liquid to a person's palm, then rubbing it in. (7) The man in the black hoodie applies the product to his face, showing skin texture. (8) He holds up a white bottle, pointing to its labels while explaining its benefits. (9) He concludes by holding the original blue bottle toward the camera with an encouraging expression.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: Two main male hosts sitting side-by-side throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One man in a dark gray hoodie with short dark hair; another man in a black Carhartt hoodie with styled dark hair and a small earring.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern studio or office background with blue-gray walls, floating shelves decorated with books, a gold-framed award, small action figures, and a round wall clock.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voices open the video with a rapid greeting. Upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a strong four-on-the-floor beat starts immediately. (2) A cheerful laughter sound effect plays as the hosts make a joke. Vocal pitch is high and varied. (3) A digital 'ding' sound effect punctuates the start of the quiz. Speech rate is fast with frequent overlapping dialogue. (4) Short 'whoosh' sounds accompany visual score updates. BGM remains constant in the background. (5) The vocal tone shifts slightly to a persuasive, informative style as the product is introduced. Music volume ducks slightly to allow the product description to be clear. (6) A soft squelching sound effect highlights the texture of the liquid being applied to the skin. (7) The video concludes with an energetic call to action, maintaining the upbeat BGM until the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Interactive Quiz -> Problem Identification -> Product Solution -> Detailed Benefits -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a relatable and humorous 'early aging' quiz to engage the audience before seamlessly transitioning into a promotion for Innisfree skincare products as a solution for maintaining a youthful appearance.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host explicitly names the brand and product, demonstrates its application, and lists technical benefits and ingredients.
